name: Baseten
description: Baseten is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Baseten is a privately held AI infrastructure company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $1.5 billion Series F round announced on June 22, 2026, valued the company at $13 billion.

Founded in 2019 and based in San Francisco, Baseten operates a platform on which companies deploy and serve AI models in production, a process known as inference. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company, except the Series C figure, which is as reported by CNBC, and the Series B figure, which is as reported by Forbes. The Series F was issued in two tranches, at valuations of $13 billion and $11 billion.
round_notes: On October 30, 2026, Bloomberg reported that Baseten was set to raise $2 billion in a round led by Sands Capital, in two tranches at valuations of $26 billion and $30 billion. Baseten has not announced that round. With its Series F announcement, the company said its revenue had grown 20 times over the prior year; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Altimeter Capital, Conviction and Spark Capital led the Series F, with Sands Capital and Wellington Management as co-leads. IVP and CapitalG led the Series E, BOND led the Series D, and IVP and Spark Capital led the Series C and Series B. Other investors include Nvidia, Greylock, Premji Invest, Blackbird, Battery Ventures, South Park Commons and D.E. Shaw Ventures.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Baseten appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Baseten's announcements of its Series F and Series E; reports by Fortune (September 2025), SiliconANGLE (September 2025 and March 2024), CNBC (February 19, 2025) and Bloomberg (October 30, 2026); reports by Forbes; and SEC Form D filings.
